rules.name: Firepower over Manoeuvrability (Rule 1)
rules.description: Russian ships of the line (1st to 3rd Rates) may take the Overgunned upgrade at a discounted cost of 80 points.

rules.name: Firepower over Manoeuvrability (Rule 3)
rules.description: Reduce the initial Ship Points values of all Russian ships by 10% (rounding down). (Not implemented on Battlescribe yet - sorry - get your calculator out!)

rules.name: Firepower over Manoeuvrability (Rule 2)
rules.description: Russian ships of the line suffer -1" to their Rate of Knots their first movement of each turn and may not purchase the Streamlined or Sturdy upgrades.

rules.name: Edinorogs
rules.description: Each turn one cannon shot by a Russian 1st to 3rd Rate ship suffers no penalty for firing at targets over 10" away.

rules.name: Resilience
rules.description: Russian ships that fail a Strike the Colours test may re-roll the test, but the result of the second test must be accepted.

rules.name: Blagodat
rules.description: Blagodat's first broadside of the game may re-roll any missed shots.

rules.name: St Pavel (Rule 1)
rules.description: St Pavel has +1 to hit bonus when shooting at shore targets

rules.name: St Pavel (Rule 2)
rules.description: She also has +1 to Skill Tests

rules.name: Azov (Rule 1)
rules.description: Azov does not suffer the -1" Rate of Knots penalty from Firepower over Manouverability.

rules.name: Azov (Rule 2)
rules.description: For every hit rolled against Azov, roll a D6. On a result of 6, the hit is ignored. Critical hits ignore this rule.

rules.name: Azov (Rule 3)
rules.description: The Azov cannot be repaired during battle.

rules.name: Admiral Fyodor Fyodorovish Ushakov (Rule 1)
rules.description: Ushakov has +1 to Skill Tests on his own ship, as well as ships of his fleet within 20".

rules.name: Admiral Fyodor Fyodorovish Ushakov (Rule 2)
rules.description: Ushakov's ship gains a +1 to hit when shooting at the enemy flagship. This is either the largest ship in the enemy fleet or, if two or more are of equal rates, one agreed beforehand to be the flagship.

rules.name: Admiral Fyodor Fyodorovish Ushakov (Rule 3)
rules.description: When sailing in a line formation that includes Ushakov's vessel, all other ships in the formation gain a +1 to hit bonus when shooting at the same target as Ushakov's vessel.

rules.name: Admiral Fyodor Fyodorovish Ushakov (Rule 4)
rules.description: Ushakov's ship will never Strike the Colours. Friendly ships within 20" gain a +1 bonus when rolling a Strike the Colours test. This is in addition to the Skill Test bonus given above

rules.name: Admiral Dmitry Nikolayevich Senyavin (Rule 1)
rules.description: May not benefit from the Special Rules of any other friendly ship or character.

rules.name: Admiral Dmitry Nikolayevich Senyavin (Rule 2)
rules.description: Ignores the -1" Rate of Knots penalty in the Russian Firepower over Manoeuvrability rule. In addition, conveys a +1 to Skill Tests to his own ships.

rules.name: Admiral Mikhail Petrovich Lazarev (Rule 1)
rules.description: After leaving by a table edge, Lazarev's ship may be brought on from any position on the same edge. It may also enter from another table edge as long as the following penalties are applied: Lazarev's ship must remain off the table and out of play for two full Turns if he re-enters via an edge adjacent to his exit position, or three Turns for the opposite edge.

rules.name: Admiral Mikhail Petrovich Lazarev (Rule 2)
rules.description: May not benefit from any other friendly ship or character's special rules

rules.name: Admiral Mikhail Petrovich Lazarev (Rule 3)
rules.description: Ignores the -1" Rate of Knots penalty in the Russian Firepower over Manoeuvrability rule. In addition, he conveys a +1 to Skill Tests by his own ship.
